You can't join alone. You need a real person to vouch; they lock 100 units for 12 epochs.

Each introducer backs at most 3. Fake it and the whole chain freezes, plus your introducer loses backing rights for 10 epochs. Star clusters get flagged fast.

What's the cost? 1,000 clones need 34 introducers locking 3,400 units; a 40% hit rate means about 13,600 lost. That's the horizon: an ocean of clones can't cross it; no cipher tricks the graph.
